messages.subject: Getting Mplus model outputs into lavaan/mlVAR model.fit form
messages.subject_clean: Getting Mplus model outputs into lavaan/mlVAR model.fit form
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am trying to get MPlus model parameters outputted from a dynamic structural equation model into a model.fit object format that matches a lavaan, mlVAR, or uSEM model object output.

The goal is to be able to use the output to run another package whose functions usually take either mlVAR or uSEM models as inputs.

Has anyone tried to reformat MPlus outputs in that way using MPlusAutomation or other solutions?

Thank you very much!
Maia

Maia ten Brink
PhD Student
Psychology Department
Stanford University
